decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the above, the development hereby permitted shall be coloured red only.
Condition : 4 - The ATM and payphone hereby permitted must be removed from the site when no longer required and the site returned to paved area.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposal to form an ATM and payphone would, because of its position, design and appearance, and having regard to the existing telephone box/kiosk, be acceptable.  The proposed development would preserve the character and appearance of the Spring Grove Conservation Area and is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-B.1.7 (Telecommunications), S.4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Change of use to form ATM and payphone.
